comment: Add fi_key, fi_rev and fi_anchor so that a page can hold several items, such as the sections of a section feed, each linked to the revision it appeared in

before.name: fedifeeds_item
before.comment: Items of a feed as they appeared. Only items recorded here were sent, so only they get Update or Delete

columns.name: fi_feed
columns.comment: Handle of the feed, such as category_4521

after.name: fedifeeds_item
after.comment: Items of a feed as they appeared. Only items recorded here were sent, so only they get Update or Delete

columns.name: fi_feed
columns.comment: Handle of the feed, such as category_4521

columns.name: fi_key
columns.comment: What tells the item apart within the page: for a section item the texts of its heading and the headings above it, one per line, or their SHA-256 when that is longer than the column; empty for a category item, which is the page itself

columns.name: fi_rev
columns.comment: The revision the item appeared in, or 0 for an item recorded before this was

columns.name: fi_anchor
columns.comment: The anchor of a section item's heading in fi_rev, as it goes in a link; empty for a category item
